posts.author: muffinswords
posts.body:
Okay, so this happened awhile ago (!)when I updated RPG Maker MV and Pixi(!) to the latest version. I've lazily ignored it until now because everything else is okay. But when the game test is in windowed mode, there are scroll bars and it cuts off a row and column of the window oddly.
This is something I'd like to fix because I'd definitely prefer for the player to have a complete windowed mode.
As mentioned, I feel positive that updating RM and Pixi was the cause. But what can I do? Thanks for reading.

posts.author: caethyril
posts.body:
I believe this can happen if you play a project running an older version of the core scripts with a newer version of the editor? Regardless, it is a good idea to keep the versions in sync to avoid various bugs.
Details for updating your RMMV project's core scripts can be found in this announcement:
Announcement - RPG Maker MV - v1.6.1 Stable Release!
6/21/2018 Everyone, please read the instructions carefully. The bugs that are being reported shouldn't happen if the correct files were even copied properly. Such examples like the "CTRL BUG" shouldn't happen if you copied index.html, package.json, the rpg*.js files and so on.  I also received...
